capability.search_portfolio: Searches Camilo Hernández's projects, blog posts, experience and skills. Returns titles, short summaries and links.
capability.get_project: Returns a case study: context, role, decisions, result and technologies.
capability.list_projects: Lists portfolio projects, optionally filtered by technology.
capability.get_experience: Returns professional experience with official titles, companies and dates.
capability.get_skills: Returns skills by area, with their level and years of use.
capability.list_posts: Lists blog posts, optionally by tag.
capability.get_cv: Returns the official CV: the LinkedIn link and the downloadable PDF on this site.
capability.set_preferences: Changes the site language or theme for this visit. It can be undone.
